description: A full replacement of the existing roof covering, including the removal of all existing slates, felt, and battens. The roof is to be re-covered using new high-quality Spanish slates. The replacement of all upstairs windows with new timber sash windows. The new windows will be double-glazed and will match the style, opening type, glazing bar pattern, and horns of the current windows. Chimney flashing works at the base of the chimney where it intersects the roof slope, to be carried out in new lead.The installation of one new conservation-style roof window (Velux) with a recessed flashing kit. The window is to be installed on the rear roof slope and will not face a highway nor project more than 150mm.
